name: Mind Anchor
description: Fix the mind on one plain thought so a stunning blow cannot shake the stance loose.

name: Clear Strike
description: Strike on a cleared mind with no wasted motion at the nearest opening.

name: Grit Breath
description: Take a gritted slow breath and pass the calm of it to an ally through a hand on the shoulder.

name: Upright Bearing
description: Keep the line straight through a stumble and step on without losing the bearing.

name: Dread Shed
description: Shake a lingering dread out of the user or an ally so panic stops wasting qi.

name: Unmoved Guard
description: Hold a guard of will around the body that does not tremble however hard the blows fall.

name: Poise Stance
description: Settle into a level stance whose weight rides evenly on both feet and absorbs a push.

name: Level Blow
description: Send a blow along a flat plane at the height of the foe's ribs with no rise or drop.

name: Stride Count
description: Count the steps of the user and the foe to judge who is tiring and when the rhythm will break.

name: Calming Touch
description: Lay two fingers on the wrist of a rattled ally and lend a beat of calm that steadies the whole arm.

name: Gliding Turn
description: Turn on the ball of the foot in one smooth arc and finish square to the foe.

name: Unyielding Counter
description: Take the first blow on a set frame and return a counter that knocks the foe's rhythm off its beat.

name: Shock Clearing
description: Wash the shock of a hard hit out of the nerves of an ally or the self so the limbs obey again.

name: Slow Burn
description: Feed a slow even heat of will into an ally so effort lasts past the first rush of a fight.

name: Long Fist
description: Throw a fist with the full reach of the arm and shoulder behind a patient advance.

name: Kept Pace
description: Hold the same measured pace across a long exchange so the legs never run ahead of the breath.

name: Burn Guard
description: Lift a slow-glowing guard of will before the chest that dulls a blow without hardening against it.

name: Char Mark
description: Gauge how much of the fire of will remains in the user so the fight is paced to what is left.

name: Ash Jab
description: Jab with a dry grey weight that leaves the foe's arm numb and slow.

name: Burn On
description: Feed a flagging ally a surge of borrowed will so the ally keeps fighting at the same pace a while longer.

name: Stoking Blow
description: Strike with a hot rising force that grows with every exchange the user has already survived.

name: Settled Fist
description: Strike calmly with a fist that shows no sign of hurry or panic.

name: Fear Hold
description: Hold the body still under a sudden threat so fear cannot pull the guard out of place.

name: Dread Reading
description: Read the fear on a foe's face and in the foe's stance to learn where the foe is weakest.

name: Soundless Pace
description: Move without a sound or a hurry and close the distance before the foe sees it close.

name: Quelling Calm
description: Quell the panic of a frightened ally or the self so reason and steady breath return.

name: Cowing Stare
description: Hold the gaze of a foe until the foe's nerve sinks and the foe's blows come slower.

name: Tempered Fist
description: Throw a fist hardened by many trials so it lands true even when the arm is tired.

name: Hardened Guard
description: Raise both forearms with the will locked behind them to take a clean hit on the bone.

name: Cool Head
description: Cool the mind in the middle of a rush and take stock of the foe and the ground.

name: Spur Word
description: Call one hard sharp word to an ally that jolts the ally out of hesitation and into motion.

name: Tempered Step
description: Cut across the foe's line with a short hard step that gives up no balance.

name: Cool Parry
description: Brush a strike aside with the back of the hand and keep the other hand ready.

name: Resolve Surge
description: Pour the whole of the will into a single blow that lands with the weight of every hit already taken.

name: Tempering Hold
description: Hold a hardening guard of will in front of the user and let its warmth strengthen the allies close behind.

name: Backlash Calm
description: Settle the wild qi of a Qi Deviation backlash in the user or an ally with a long steady pressure of will.

name: Heavy Breath
description: Breathe deep and slow beside an ally under a heavy load so the load is carried on a steady rhythm.

name: Load Stance
description: Spread the stance wide and take a crushing blow down through the legs into the floor.

name: Load Strike
description: Strike with the whole sagging weight of the body dropped into the fist.

name: Shift Weight
description: Shift the weight from foot to foot so a heavy blow slides past instead of landing square.

name: Laden Step
description: Advance under a pressing burden one planted pace at a time without losing the line.

name: Burden Shrug
description: Shrug off a pressing weight or a will-bowing aura so the force fails to take hold of the user.

name: Load Unbinding
description: Lift the weight of a binding or a crushing pressure from a pinned ally so the ally can rise.

name: Keeper's Coal
description: Pass a small kept coal of will from the user's chest into an ally to hold off the cold of fatigue.

name: Glowing Fist
description: Hit with a fist that glows faintly with the will packed behind it.

name: Ember Cover
description: Cup a faint dull glow over the chest to turn away a light blade or a thrown stone.

name: Ember Sight
description: See the faint glow of will in those nearby and judge who in the group is nearest to breaking.

name: Ember Shift
description: Shift a pace sideways on a flicker of will and leave the foe's blow to pass through empty air.

name: Ember Clasp
description: Clasp a foe's forearm in a hot grip that ruins the foe's aim for one breath.

name: Ember Fanning
description: Fan the glow of an ally's own will until it burns bright enough to carry the ally through the next clash.

name: Ember Burst
description: Flare the kept flame all at once through a single strike that bursts hot against the foe's guard.
